manifest_note: Pre-run FROZEN design. Freezes the disjoint shells (KiDS/HSC bands + CMB-lensing L_eff-tertiles), the row-count-null normalization N=Xi/q_row_0.95, the slack-anchored excess-price models + power rule, the C+Omega floor LISTS + per-floor Sigma recipe, Delta_margin=0.10, the M_sys regressors, and the model/LOFO design BEFORE any residual price. Builder is FORBIDDEN from changing shells/budgets/thresholds after inspecting pi. Validated by tests/test_e5sp_manifest.py.

decisive_observable.name: budgeted obstruction-price field pi_{f,s}
decisive_observable.formula: pi_{f,s} = [ lambda_max( Xi_{f,s} / q_row_0.95(f,s) ) - Omega_{f,s} ]_+   (N_{f,s}(Xi) = Xi / q_row_0.95)
decisive_observable.Xi_C: Xi_{f,s} = K_DD - K_DL K_LL_dagger K_LD on the DISJOINT shell s (Schur adequacy residual; computed not shaped)
decisive_observable.N_normalization: ROW-COUNT-NULL normalized spectral statistic (reviewer freeze 2.1): N_{f,s}(Xi) = Xi / q_row_0.95(f,s). NOT a fixed-rank projection (which can hide real shell structure or make the top eigenvalue arbitrary), and H' is NOT added as extra points.

row_count_null.q_row_0.95: q_row_0.95(f,s) = Q_0.95[ lambda_max(Xi_rownull_{f,s}) ] -- the 95th percentile of the top eigenvalue over equal-row-count, covariance-respecting row-null surrogate shells; this is the normalizer denominator
rownull_matches: same shell row count / effective row count
row_count_null.draws_B: B >= 2000 row-null draws per shell (B = 1000 acceptable if runtime becomes painful)
row_count_null.uncertainty_reporting: report SE / bootstrap uncertainty on q_row_0.95 per shell; if the 95th-percentile uncertainty would change a pass/fail boundary, rerun that shell at B=5000 (reviewer freeze 2026-06-02, non-blocking)

non_degeneracy_guarantees: row-count-null normalization (Xi/q_row_0.95; the row-count floor maps to a unit threshold)
scrambled shell order must NOT reproduce the heterogeneity relation

heterogeneity_proxy.window_W: survey/window/stage kernel per shell (KiDS COSEBIs filter support; HSC ell-band window; CMB-lensing L-band window)
heterogeneity_proxy.backend: physical CCL P_nl/P_lin at the shell effective (k,z) weighted by W_{f,s}; from the frozen geometry posterior
heterogeneity_proxy.blinding: compute + FREEZE the full H table (results/E5SP/H_proxy_table.csv) BEFORE any pi is evaluated; proxy independent of residual outcome

stage_shells_DISJOINT.rule: DISJOINT incremental shells; NOT cumulative. Builder cannot change after inspecting pi.

CMB-lensing.type: lensing L bands -- three EQUAL-COUNT contiguous groups ordered by bandpower effective multipole L_eff (reviewer 2.4)
CMB-lensing.shells: CMB-L-low = first floor(n_L/3) bandpowers by L_eff; CMB-L-mid = next floor(n_L/3); CMB-L-high = remaining bandpowers. (For n_L=35: 12/12/11.) Membership FROZEN before H is computed; record actual (L_min, L_max, L_eff) per shell in the H table.
CMB-lensing.ordering: ascending bandpower effective multipole L_eff (NOT hand-picked physical boundaries, NOT chosen after seeing H or pi)
CMB-lensing.lofo_role: HELD-OUT family for the LOFO model comparison; the three L_eff-tertile shells give a within-family slope test (>=2 disjoint shells satisfied)

stage_shells_DISJOINT.too_few_shells_rule: a family with <2 disjoint shells may be a HELD-OUT family but NOT a within-family slope test (Gate 0)

L_geom.definition: growth-prediction tangent/subspace induced by the frozen E1/E2 w0wa geometry posterior (runs/E1/E1C_C3_w0wa)
L_geom.construction: for each theta_i: y_{f,s}(theta_i,nu) via pyccl -> project/marginalize legal nu -> whiten Sigma_total^{-1/2} -> SVD/PCA keep sigma_k/sigma_1>=tau_L=1e-3 -> P_L (C-orthogonal) -> Xi_C=T_D(I-P_L)T_D*
L_geom.rank_check: L_geom rank must RESOLVE the ~5-7 geometry dof (the old N=4 -> rank 3 was the under-resolution bug); record the rank

audit_metric_C_and_covariance_floors.shared_WL_rule: result may NOT pass under diagonal-only cross-family covariance if it fails under conservative shared-WL covariance (rho_KH stress)
audit_metric_C_and_covariance_floors.Sigma_estimation: per shell: Sigma_nuisance = J_nu Pi_nu J_nu^T (nu = legal nuisance params for that family); KiDS/HSC include IA + photo-z + shear-cal + baryon/theory + KiDS<->HSC shared-WL, and HSC adds Omega_HSC-pipeline (Fourier/real-space transfer); CMB-lensing includes published bandpower covariance + lensing-cal + foreground/response + approximation floors from the release (if a floor is unavailable, use a DECLARED diagonal fractional theory floor and MARK it); Sigma_theory = nonlinear-power model-spread envelope (baryon proxies are theory floors, not decisive physics); Sigma_approximation = pyccl/CLASS mismatch (G-ENV-4) + interpolation/integration + covariance-conditioning floor. Every Sigma_total must be PD with condition number within the gate; else the shell is BLOCKED or regularized by a pre-declared jitter floor.

Omega_budget.formula: Omega_{f,s} = max(Omega_same-family, Omega_linear/synthetic, Omega_nuisance/systematics, Omega_theory, Omega_row-count, Omega_proxy) + Delta_margin
Omega_budget.Omega_linear_synthetic: synthetic data with P_nl = P_lin (no-obstruction control)
Omega_budget.Omega_row_count: = 1 in the N_{f,s}-normalized spectral units (reviewer 2.1): q_row_0.95 absorbs the row-count floor into a unit threshold, kept as an explicit audit term. Optional 2nd row-count stress: Q_0.95[ lambda_max(Xi_rownull)/q_row_0.95 ] which should be ~1 -- report deviations. (equal-row-count covariance-respecting Gaussian/surrogate null)
Omega_budget.Delta_margin: = 0.10 in the N_{f,s}-normalized spectral units (reviewer 2.4); report sensitivity at {0.05, 0.10, 0.20}; PRIMARY status uses 0.10; do not change after seeing pi
Omega_budget.frozen: estimated on the DECLARATION split and frozen BEFORE witness evaluation

models.dependent_variable: y_{f,s} = pi_{f,s} - pi_bar_{f,slack}, where pi_bar_{f,slack} = median{ pi_{f,s} : H_{f,s} <= H_slack } -- the SLACK-ANCHORED EXCESS price (reviewer 2.2). Removes the per-family offset so intercepts cannot carry the result; do NOT fit a held-out family intercept under LOFO.
models.M_Lambda: y = 0 (smooth geometry / Lambda / w0wa chart; no excess price)
models.M_U: y = lambda_U + eps (universal new layer; NO H dependence; roughly stage/family-invariant after legal normalization; F18 lawhood required, Gate 6). CANDIDATE only if it does NOT reduce to heterogeneity (H), row count, or nuisance floors
models.M_F4_SP: y = A*[H_{f,s} - H_slack]_+ + eps, A>0 (shadow-price of obstruction; PRIMARY; slack-anchored so no per-family intercept carries it)
models.M_sys: y = Z_{f,s} beta + eps with pre-registered Z = [1, I_WL, log10 kappa(Sigma_{f,s}), log r_eff(f,s), U_{f,s}, P_{f,s}] (see M_sys_regressors); ridge / Bayesian shrinkage fixed BEFORE comparison; same BIC/LOO penalty. EXCLUDE H, H', k_eff, L_eff from the primary M_sys (else it collapses into the heterogeneity model). If M_sys beats M_F4/SP under LOFO -> status systematics-proxy (NOT shadow-price)
models.M_row: y = beta0 + beta1 * log(r_eff(f,s)) + eps (explicit row-count-artifact diagnosis; r_eff = shell effective rank / whitened DOF)

M_sys_regressors.Z: [ 1, I_WL, log10 kappa(Sigma_{f,s}), log r_eff(f,s), U_{f,s}, P_{f,s} ]
M_sys_regressors.kappa: covariance condition number kappa(Sigma_{f,s}) after regularization
M_sys_regressors.P: pipeline flag: KiDS COSEBIs / HSC Fourier / CMB-lensing bandpower
M_sys_regressors.fit: ridge or Bayesian shrinkage fixed before comparison; penalized by the same BIC/LOO rules; H/H'/k_eff/L_eff are NOT primary regressors (sensitivity diagnostics only)

models.comparison: LOFO over families: train on 2, predict held-out 3rd, rotate over all three; Delta_elpd>=2*SE OR Delta_BIC>=6, all-family-consistent
models.H_prime_not_extra_points: H' is robustness only -- NEVER added as independent observations to gain power
models.no_finer_shells_after_pi: do not create finer shells after seeing pi; finer shells allowed ONLY if declared before Phase B and each passes nonvacuity + covariance conditioning

power_rule.note: low power by construction (3 families, ~10-13 shell rows); the result is ALLOWED to become underpowered-nonvacuous-fail / characterization (reviewer 2.2)
decisive_requires_all: >= 3 families each with >= 2 disjoint shells after nuisance projection
each family has >= 1 slack shell (H<=H_slack) AND >= 1 binding shell (H>H_slack)

slack.robustness: bottom-quartile of H -- ROBUSTNESS / CHARACTERIZATION variant ONLY, never the decisive threshold (reviewer 2.3)
slack.per_family_anchor: decisive continuation requires, for EACH family f: count(H_{f,s}<=0.05)>=1 (a slack shell) AND count(H_{f,s}>0.05)>=1 (a binding shell). A family lacking a slack shell can characterize pi-vs-H but CANNOT claim slack-to-binding emergence.
slack.phase_B_stop: Phase B computes results/E5SP/H_proxy_table.csv FIRST and STOPS (no pi computed) if the per-family slack/binding/nonvacuity condition fails.
slack.no_slack_set_rule: if no slack set exists on available data, the experiment becomes CHARACTERIZATION, not a decisive test

gates.G-E5SP-0_support_nonvacuity: reuse G-E5-NONVAC: ||t_{f,s}||_post >= 2.0 AND retained >= 0.25; each family >=2 disjoint shells after nuisance projection; fail -> diagnostic not decisive
gates.G-E5SP-1_budgeted_obstruction: pi_{f,s}>0 with bootstrap CI excluding 0 on >=1 held-out shell per held-out family (NECESSARY not sufficient)
gates.G-E5SP-2_slack_regime: S_slack={(f,s):H<=H_slack=0.05 in window-averaged log(P_nl/P_lin)} has pi=0 within uncertainty AND below Omega; REQUIRES each family to have >=1 slack shell AND >=1 binding shell (reviewer 2.3); bottom-quartile-of-H is robustness/characterization ONLY; no slack set, or any family lacking a slack shell -> characterization, not decisive
gates.G-E5SP-3_binding_heterogeneity: on the SLACK-ANCHORED excess price y=pi-pi_bar_{f,slack} (reviewer 2.2), y increases with H on non-slack shells; M_F4/SP beats M_Lambda AND M_U AND M_sys on held-out LOFO by Delta_elpd>=2*SE OR Delta_BIC>=6, all-family-consistent, A>0 CI!=0; decisive ONLY if the power_rule holds (>=3 families x >=2 shells, >=1 slack & >=1 binding per family, >=9 rows)
gates.G-E5SP-4_proxy_failure_no_manufacture: H beats ALL of: shuffled-H, reversed-stage-order, scale-matched-noise, row-count, survey-label, cumulative-row
gates.G-E5SP-5_zero_controls: signal vanishes under: (1) P_nl=P_lin synthetic; (2) shuffled stage labels; (3) equal-row-count Gaussian residuals; (4) same-family saturation; (5) held-out family's stage vector removed from BOTH L and D; (6) random orthogonal rotations that PRESERVE the covariance but DESTROY the window/heterogeneity (W_{f,s}/H) alignment
gates.G-E5SP-6_F18_discriminator: if M_U beats M_F4/SP -> candidate universal layer + F18 lawhood (factor through access quotient, fixed support, stable across family/probe, not survey-label, survives H-scramble); fail F18 -> systematics/proxy

phases.B: compute + FREEZE H proxy table FIRST (results/E5SP/H_proxy_table.csv; columns: family, shell, H, H_prime, window, z_eff, k_eff, L_min, L_max, L_eff [CMB-lensing -- records the frozen L_eff-ordering provenance per reviewer 2.4], slack/binding label), before any pi
phases.C: build price field results/E5SP/price_field.csv (columns: f, s, lambda_max, Omega, pi, L_geom_rank [resolution check - must NOT be 3], shell_effective_rank [per-shell rank used by N_{f,s} - the row-count-invariance check], null floors, bootstrap CI; fixed Schur carrier, frozen Omega)
phases.D: model comparison M_Lambda/M_U/M_F4_SP/M_sys/M_row, LOFO over families
phases.E: controls (Gate 4/5 no-manufacture); require the real H-based model to survive

inputs_discard: results/E5/E5_status.json (v3A terminal run record: design_version=v3A, cumulative lambda_max folds, N=4/rank-3 carrier)
ANY results/E5 file with design_version in {E5-minimal-physical-v2, v3A} or the cumulative-lambda_max observable
naming_discipline: call pi a CANDIDATE obstruction price until it passes budgeted-positivity ^ slack ^ heterogeneity ^ held-out ^ proxy/scramble-failure
call the test F4-COMPATIBLE/inspired, NOT a proven Local-Global Obstruction (no F4 claim without the local-family/global-package map)
the test must NOT reduce to 'does Xi beat w0wa on geometry'

resolved_freeze_patch.note: The five formerly-open items were RESOLVED by the reviewer's exact freeze patch (results/provenance/decommissioned_plan_agent_sources.json#e5sp_freeze_ruling, sections 2.1-2.5), applied 2026-06-02. No item remains provisional.

items.N_normalization: RESOLVED 2.1 -> N_{f,s}(Xi)=Xi/q_row_0.95(f,s), the row-count-null normalized spectral statistic (decisive_observable.row_count_null). NOT fixed-rank projection.
items.statistical_power: RESOLVED 2.2 -> slack-anchored excess price y=pi-pi_bar_{f,slack} (no family intercept); power_rule: >=3 families x >=2 shells, >=1 slack & >=1 binding per family, >=9 rows, else underpowered-nonvacuous-fail; H' NOT added as extra points.
items.slack_existence: RESOLVED 2.3 -> H_slack=0.05 kept; per-family >=1 slack & >=1 binding shell required; bottom-quartile = robustness only; Phase B STOPS if it fails.
items.CMB_and_floors: RESOLVED 2.4 -> CMB-lensing = three equal-count L_eff-ordered tertile shells; per-floor Sigma recipe (audit_metric_C_and_covariance_floors.Sigma_estimation); Delta_margin=0.10 normalized units (sensitivity {0.05,0.10,0.20}).
items.M_sys: RESOLVED 2.5 -> Z=[1,I_WL,log10 kappa(Sigma),log r_eff,U,P] with ridge/shrinkage fixed before comparison; H/H'/k_eff/L_eff excluded; M_row=beta0+beta1 log r_eff.
